item.text:
Replaced the dashboard’s [UserProfile placeholder](/workspace/app/UserProfile.tsx) with an async server component. It fetches `/api/users/profile`, forwards the request cookie, and displays the returned name and email. It shows an error message if the request fails or the response is invalid.

Type checking and the production build passed. This repository has no `/api/users/profile` handler, so profile details will appear once that endpoint is available.
